title: Chicken Normandy (Escalope de Poulet a la Normande)
description: Normandy chicken is a classic French dish featuring tender chicken breasts cooked in a tasty cream sauce with mushrooms and tangy Dijon mustard.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil, or as needed
1 tablespoon Dijon mustard, or more to taste
salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
2 cups hot cooked rice, or as needed

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and sear until lightly browned, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Remove from the skillet.
Add drained mushrooms to the juices in the skillet and cook until they start to pop, about 5 minutes.

Whisk together cream, egg yolk, Dijon mustard, salt, and pepper in a small bowl; pour into the skillet with the mushrooms. Return chicken breasts to the skillet and simmer over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally to prevent the egg yolk from setting, until chicken is no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, 15 to 20 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center of the chicken breast should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).

video.description: In this video, learn how to make chicken Normandy, a classic European recipe that’s filled with rustic, earthy flavor from the mushrooms and creamy sauce. Make sure to use fresh, tender chicken breasts, and make small adjustments to the sauce in order to get the perfect texture. To thicken the sauce, mix cornstarch with a bit of water and add the mixture to the skillet; the sauce should coat the pieces of chicken.
